# Read-only missing html lang

Next slice of LIM-e872b1. Extends `limatus usability scan` only.

## DoD

- Same CLI. New kind: `missing_lang`.
- Profile: `lang.flagMissing` boolean, default **true**. Unknown keys rejected. Existing profiles still load.
- When false, never emit this kind.
- Flag the root `<html>` element when it has no `lang` attribute or `lang` is whitespace-only. Do **not** flag if `lang` is present (any non-empty value, including `und`). Do **not** invent a language. Do **not** walk nested elements for xml:lang.
- If there is no `<html>` element (fragment), flag the document root with selector `html` only if you can identify a top-level `html` node; fragments without `<html>` → **no** finding (avoid punishing partial snippets).
- JSON: `id`, `kind`, `selector`, `rationale`. Selector should be `html` when the element exists.
- Update the kinds list in `src/limatus/data/SKILL.md` HTML usability section to include `missing_lang`.
- Tests (tempfile): `<html><body></body></html>` flags; `<html lang="en">` does not; `minimal.html` / `both-findings.html` already have lang so they must not gain this kind; flagMissing false suppresses.
- `PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests -q`

## Out of scope

- hreflang, content-language headers, decide/apply, live URLs

## Layout

- Worktree: `/tmp/limatus-e872b1-missing-lang` from `origin/main`
- Branch: `feat/LIM-<this-id>-usability-missing-lang`
- PR target: **main**
